matchedControlFinding.evidence: the unperturbed incumbent publishes nothing at any of the six bounds; 10 of 12 perturbed states publish, best gain 0.032 mm; session-wide over 504 perturbed mode-31 runs, k=2 and k=3 with d<=2.0 lead at 14.3% publication rate, k=4/d=3.5 and k=6/d=3.5 are dead at 0/42, control 1/30
matchedControlFinding.mechanism: the cumulative displacement cap is 8x the largest deficit asked for; the control fails with displacementCapped=true and only 6 pairs left, while a d-mm nudge manufactures d-mm deficits and so buys an 8d-mm cap - which is also why large d fails: it hands the solver more residue than the bound leaves room for
matchedControlFinding.productiveBand: narrow and non-monotone: eps in {0.006, 0.012, 0.025} publish (27.8/27.8/16.7%); fourteen other eps values from 0.001 to 0.2 are 0/276 combined; eps >= 0.035 is 0/336 across every case - the layout has no 0.05 mm of redistributable slack anywhere on this frontier
